title: microtoena delavayi var. vera
intro: Microtoena delavayi var. vera, commonly known as Vera's Mint, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family, known for its unique and distinct characteristics. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Vera's Mint include its use as a carminative, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic agent, making it a potential remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Vera's Mint include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
